author: Christer Lundin
releaseNotes:
v1.3.1: Resilience — one member device failing to update can no longer stall the poll for other members (that member holds last-known state and retries next poll, everyone else updates normally), and a failed device creation now logs the actual cause: a device-network-id collision (usually an orphaned member device from a previous install) is reported as exactly that, with the fix, instead of blaming missing driver code.

v1.3.0: Safety Zone status on every member device. Two new attributes: safetyStatus (at_area / in_zone / out_of_zone / stale / unknown — the member's position relative to their own usual area, computed server-side from their saved places) and outsideUsualArea (strictly "true"/"false", so a Rule Machine trigger on it fires exactly when someone is CONFIRMED outside their usual area — stale or unknown never count as outside). Still area names only, never coordinates. Shows "unknown" until the PositionGuard server has the safety feature enabled for your account's groups; no new endpoints and no configuration needed.
